front.label: Front
front.desc: An aurora of pulse lines behind the Hyperliquid India Hypurr, your name and your number.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name. It stays off the card until you are eligible, then the laser writes it live, line by line.

front.label: Aurora
front.desc: Thirty four stacked pulse lines, each hiding the one behind it, rising into curtains: ENS blue at the back, mint at the front.

front.label: Hypurr
front.desc: The Hyperliquid India Hypurr in headphones. Its fur is packed with polished bubbles, mint where the artwork is green, and its outline is typed in your namehash.

front.label: Number
front.desc: Your card out of 25, in dot matrix. The laser etches it right after your name.

back.label: Back
back.desc: Hyperliquid in words and numbers, with the logo x logo at the centre.

back.label: Logo x logo
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS at the centre of the back, the only marks on it.

back.label: Hyperliquid words
back.desc: The vocabulary of Hyperliquid: HyperCore, HyperEVM, HyperBFT, order book, HLP, vaults, HIP-1 to HIP-3, builder codes, Assistance Fund, CoreWriter and more.

back.label: The numbers
back.desc: Set quieter among the words: TGE 29.11.2024, 1,000,000,000 max supply, 310,000,000 airdrop to 94,023 genesis wallets, the allocation split, 200,000 orders per second at 0.2 s median latency.
